objectives.handoff: Flow matching on successful real continuation action chunks at states reached by a different source policy; update the selected target adapter only.
objectives.call: Masked binary cross entropy for actually attempted policies completing the task within a specified action budget; untried policies are unlabelled, not failures.

gradient_ownership.inactive_adapters: no optimizer step or momentum/weight-decay update
gradient_ownership.shared_call_head: call-loss gradients only; current-observation features are stop-gradient

calling_head.input: 2048-D masked-mean frozen VLM prefix + 32-D normalized state + log1p(action_budget)/log(1001)
calling_head.lifecycle: Record label-generating policy bundle IDs. After adapters change, collect fresh outcomes and validate/calibrate scores before using them as deployment success probabilities. No automatic live harness routing change.

data_requirements.manifest: Unified schema-v1 real-rollout manifest with SHA-256-bound NPZ samples, base-inventory and normalization bindings
data_requirements.handoff: Different source/target policy; target is an adapter; verified successful continuation or expert recovery; raw LIBERO delta action chunks [10,7]
data_requirements.call: Single attempted policy until terminal state or budget; zero intervening policy switches; interrupted/infra-error runs are excluded, not failures
data_requirements.features: Current RGB cameras, proprioception, task prompt and assigned budget only; no future/terminal observations or success labels in network inputs
data_requirements.splits: Root episode groups must not cross training and validation. Official evaluation records are forbidden as training input.

activation.dedicated_launch: Default requires --rollout-manifest and --require-joint-losses; refuses missing labels rather than silently running a baseline. An explicitly approved Stage A run must pass --fm-only, which rejects joint-loss inputs.
activation.explicit_baseline: Named launcher --fm-only resolves both auxiliary weights to zero and records user_explicit_stage_a_fm_only. Generic Python runner without a manifest retains its backward-compatible FM path and logs disabled reasons.
activation.strict_coverage: Training handoff labels for all four target adapters and at least one uncensored training call outcome for each of the five callable policies; never fabricate missing negatives

claim_boundary: Joint objective, shared calling head and cross-policy state-distribution supervision; not differentiable end-to-end simulation, not guaranteed direct parameter coupling between adapter banks, and not yet demonstrated benchmark gains.
